decisions.reason: Waiting to add the Sensor board to the combined order does not change its required production-file package.
The ordering sequence does not change the content or assembly-readiness requirements of the Sensor board BOM.
The reference to missing parts explains why ordering must wait but does not change any component-selection or sourceability policy.
The decision about when to place the combined manufacturing order has no effect on KiCad project portability.
Adding the Sensor board to a later combined order does not alter the boards' power or signal interface specifications.
The manufacturing-order sequence does not change the Sensor board connector inventory or module interfaces.
The ordering delay and combined-order plan do not change rail-monitoring behavior or coverage.
The order sequence does not alter the required SPS30 SEL connection or I2C operating mode.
The source decision does not change the Sensor board's logic-level or level-shifting requirements.
The combined manufacturing-order plan does not modify the Main board's dimensions, placement, or connector-layout constraints.
Adding the Sensor board to the order after missing parts are resolved does not modify its mechanical-layout requirements.
The manufacturing-order timing does not affect DCDC1 voltage configuration or 3.3V regulation behavior.
